blocks.p: This is a walkthrough for characters that have saved most of the pre-Searing quests for a higher level, with as little fighting and backtracking as possible. The map shows pre-Searing Ascalon and its outposts; each group of the route below starts at a map travel to one of them, or at a portal.

ul: Every primary and secondary profession quest, for their skills.
The Piken Square quests, through {quest:101300} ({hero:38} as a hero).

blocks.note: Note: this route was computer generated and hasn't been checked in a playthrough yet.

steps.t: Talk to the Town Crier.
Cross the bridge to Sir Tydus at the Academy gate.
Talk to Baron Egan, Namar and Sandre Elek.
Talk to Gwen, behind the resurrection shrine on your left, and to Haversdan, right outside the gate.
Just west of the city portal, wait for Prince Rurik and Captain Osric to finish talking, then talk to Osric.
Go south to the river and pick up the Broken Flute on the far shore. Keep it for now.
Go slightly uphill to Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn.
Lead Fadden into the cave and keep him safe while he gathers eggs.
Go on to the end of the cave and kill the Plague Devourer; pick up a poisonous stinger.
Back to Duke Gaban: he gives you 2 devourer eggs.
Follow the road southwest to Ashford village. Talk to Devona.
Talk to Devona again, follow her across the bridge and kill the grawl.
Talk to Pitney, next to Devona, give him an egg, follow him to his field and kill the Worm Queen. Don't leave the area meanwhile, or you need another egg.
Talk to Pitney again, Chantalle the Troubadour and Alison the Tanner.
Talk to Miller Upton, then lure the three bee swarms across the bridge with the honeycomb and return to him.
Open the Beautiful Shell near the watermill for the Beautiful Pearl.
Pick up the Beautiful Feather on the hill in the middle of the village.
Talk to Meerak the Scribe, and give Brother Mhenlo the stinger.
Cross the worm field to the bandit camp, and go on northeast up the mountain pass to the chest with the Beautiful Pendant.
Back at the bandit camp, take the Ashford strongbox, fighting only what notices you.
Carry the strongbox to Devona on foot: map travel loses it.
Give Armin Saberlin the message, and talk to Prince Rurik.
Ask Brother Mhenlo about the Charr ranger.
Necromancer Munne is on your right: ask about the Charr, and take the candles.
Light the four braziers in the order the map shows. Swamp water drains health, and dying loses the candles.
Find the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird in the south, past the corridor of undead.
Find Oberan the Reviled, toward the Green Hills County exit, and ask him about the Charr ranger for the Sharp Charr Tooth.
Talk to Munne, right by the entrance.
In Ashford village, give Pitney the news, and talk to Devona.
Go north from Ashford to the Green Hills County portal.
By the Balthazar statue just past the portal, talk to Grazden the Protector for the tithe, and question him, Farrah Cappo and Kasha Blackblood.
Talk to Duke Barradin.
Talk to Ralena Stormbringer.
Kill black bears for a bear pelt on the way to Orion: northeast along the road to the house on the left, then west through the trees.
Give Lord Darrin the message.
Talk to Mary Malone, right outside Fort Ranik. Go south then east to the arches, kill the spiders and bring her the Basket of Apples on foot.
Head southwest toward Wizard's Folly. Just before the exit, go south to the healing spring and use it to purify the hunter's horn.
Go west along the river to the fishing village, then south and east to Aidan.
In Ashford village, talk to Devona, and to Alison the Tanner, who turns the pelt into a cloak.
Give Little Thom the cloak.
Talk to Sandre Elek and Prince Rurik; Rurik then gives you the next quest.
Talk to Armin Saberlin and pick your secondary profession, then talk to Sir Tydus, then the Town Crier.
Give Gwen her flute.
Give Captain Osric the feather, the pearl and the pendant: he turns down the first two and takes the third.
Meet Rurik just outside and follow him to the Northlands gate; let him and his allies kill the Charr. Get the reward from him there.
